Question: "Is Vision Zero reducing the number of pedestrians and cyclists killed or seriously injured in Montgomery County?"

Hypothesis:

1. Since Vision Zero began, the number of pedestrians and cyclists killed or seriously injured has NOT declined significantly.
2. Most serious pedestrian and cyclist crashes happen on major state-run roads.
3. Completed safety projects saw larger declines than similar High Injury Network corridors without projects.



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

Here is the nonmotorist data:

THIS DATA COVERS:

This is data from the Montgomery County Government that shows individual records of nonmotorist crashes in Montgomery County (one row per person). It is updated weekly by the county, but I will only use full calendar years of data (January 1, 2015 to December 31, 2025. All these crashes come from police reports that are filed through the Automated Crash Reporting System (ACRS). 

Format: CSV


Most important columns: date, non-motorist type, route type, road name, injury severity
What's missing: Data for crashes on interstates and the ICC (Maryland Route 200), High Injury Network and project maps



```{r}

nonmotorists <- read_csv ("https://data.montgomerycountymd.gov/api/views/n7fk-dce5/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD")

```

Here is the incidents dataset:


This table has one row per every crash: every traffic collision reported on local and county roads in Montgomery County, NOT JUST ones involving cyclists or pedestrians. Data runs from January 1, 2015 to December 31, 2025 (will only use full years of data).

Format: CSV

```{r}
incidents <- read_csv ("https://data.montgomerycountymd.gov/api/views/bhju-22kf/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD")
```


High Injury Map (NEED TO FIX- not properly loaded)


Format: ArcGIS map (very large)

This will be a map of road corridors in the county that have the most serious and fatal crashes. These are the roads the county has prioritized is prioritizing for safety projects. It's published from the county.


```{r}
high_injury <- read_csv ("https://www.arcgis.com/apps/mapviewer/index.html?webmap=64c23bf31da64d36a87b21a39db75aec")
```
